scope: Third-party binary/bundled assets: all vendor/** files, all textures/** files, and all root *.woff files. First-party source code is NOT listed here (see repositoryCode).

statusLegend.verified: A license and its applicability are established by evidence contained in the repository (e.g. an embedded license notice); attribution requirements are recorded.
statusLegend.unresolved: The asset is present but no in-repo evidence establishes its license or redistribution rights. Treated as a release blocker until provenance/license is documented.

repositoryCode.appliesTo: First-party source files (HTML/CSS/JS) authored for this project.
repositoryCode.doesNotCover: vendor/** (Three.js is separately MIT), textures/** and *.woff (separate provenance; see assets). The repository MIT license does not, by itself, grant rights to bundled third-party files.
